name: Product Vision & Strategy
description: Define the product vision, articulate the value proposition, and align stakeholders around a shared strategic direction. Covers product strategy, roadmapping, and strategic alignment across teams and business units.

name: Service Design & Journey Mapping
description: Design end-to-end service experiences by mapping frontstage and backstage interactions, identifying gaps, and orchestrating touchpoints across channels. Includes journey mapping, service blueprints, and touchpoint optimization.

name: Experience Strategy & Governance
description: Establish experience strategy frameworks, maturity assessment, and governance models. Includes design maturity benchmarking, capability building roadmaps, and organizational alignment for sustained experience excellence.

name: UX/UI Design & Architecture
description: End-to-end UX/UI design from information architecture and interaction design through high-fidelity visual interfaces. Covers navigation patterns, interaction flows, responsive design, and pixel-perfect production-ready UI.

name: Rapid Prototyping & Validation
description: Rapidly generate interactive prototypes using AI-assisted tools, conduct usability testing, and run structured validation sessions with users and stakeholders to validate design decisions and test assumptions before development.

name: Design Systems
description: Comprehensive design system development from architecture through implementation and governance. Includes component libraries, design tokens, documentation, naming conventions, versioning, contribution workflows, and cross-team adoption frameworks.

name: AI-Powered MVP Development
description: Use AI-assisted tools (Factory.AI) to rapidly generate functional MVPs and working prototypes, compressing the path from concept to testable product. Accelerate hypothesis-to-proof cycles with lean experimentation and automated development.

name: Digital Brand Identity & Systems
description: Develop comprehensive digital brand identity systems covering logos, visual identity, color palettes, typography, iconography, motion design, and reusable brand asset libraries. Translate offline brand guidelines into digital expressions across all platforms.

name: Brand Expression for Design Systems
description: Define how brand identity is expressed within design systems through token mapping, component theming, brand-aware interaction patterns, and systematic brand application frameworks that ensure consistency at scale.

name: Marketing Strategy & Positioning
description: Develop marketing strategies, brand positioning, go-to-market plans, and communication frameworks that amplify product impact. Covers market analysis, competitive positioning, messaging architecture, and campaign strategy.

name: Facilitation & Serious Gaming
description: Design and facilitate immersive workshops using serious gaming mechanics, custom game development, and gamification to drive engagement, strategic thinking, creative problem-solving, and collective decision-making. Includes Transfopoly and custom serious games.

name: Spatial & 3D Experiences
description: Transform complex data into spatial visualizations, create 3D digital twins for products and facilities, and build browser-native interactive 3D experiences. Enables virtual walkthroughs, configuration, and immersive data exploration.

name: AR/VR Applications
description: Deploy augmented and virtual reality solutions for service operations, field support, remote assistance, and enhanced situational awareness. Real-time AR overlays and immersive VR environments for training and operations.

name: Immersive Training & Learning
description: Design and build immersive training and onboarding environments that accelerate learning, improve retention, and simulate real-world scenarios through interactive, gamified learning experiences.

name: Agile Product Delivery
description: Embed design into agile and hybrid delivery workflows with continuous collaboration between design, product, and engineering. Covers backlog structuring, prioritization, release planning, and sprint-level design delivery aligned to business value.

name: Design-to-Development Operations
description: Establish efficient design-to-development handoff processes with clear specs, redlines, design systems integration, and continuous feedback loops. Ensure seamless collaboration and iteration between design and engineering teams.

name: Experience Measurement & Optimization
description: Define experience KPIs, implement measurement frameworks, analytics instrumentation, and establish optimization loops to continuously improve product experiences. Data-driven experience refinement and impact tracking.

name: Value Proposition Canvas
description: Structured framework for mapping customer jobs, pains, and gains against product features and value creators. Ensures product vision is rooted in real user needs.

name: Service Blueprint Framework
description: Methodology for mapping the full service ecosystem: user actions, frontstage touchpoints, backstage processes, and support systems in a single visual artifact.

name: Double Diamond
description: Overarching design process framework with four phases: Discover, Define, Develop, Deliver. Guides teams from problem exploration through solution delivery with structured divergent/convergent thinking.

name: Atomic Design Methodology
description: Design system architecture methodology that structures UI into five levels: atoms, molecules, organisms, templates, and pages. Ensures systematic, scalable component design.

name: Dual-Track Agile
description: Product delivery framework that runs discovery and delivery in parallel tracks. Design validates ideas while engineering builds proven solutions, ensuring continuous flow of validated work.

name: Design Maturity Model
description: Assessment framework that benchmarks an organization's design capability across dimensions: process, talent, tools, culture, and impact. Produces a maturity score and improvement roadmap.

name: Figma
description: Collaborative design platform for UI/UX design, prototyping, design systems, and real-time team collaboration. Primary design tool across all service areas.

name: Adobe Creative Suite
description: Professional creative toolset for visual identity, illustration, motion design, image editing, and brand asset production (Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, etc.).

name: Figma (Prototyping)
description: Used for rapid interactive prototyping, concept visualization, and stakeholder walkthroughs in the rapid prototyping workflow.

name: Factory.AI
description: AI-powered development platform for accelerated code generation, rapid MVP building, and automated prototyping from design to working software.

name: NEXUS Digital
description: Outil de décision collective mobilisé en temps réel. NEXUS permet aux participants de soumettre, scorer et arbitrer leurs idées sur 4 dimensions pondérées adaptables : Pertinence, Créativité, Faisabilité, Éco-responsabilité. Résultat : des décisions collectives traçables, comparables et actionnables immédiatement.

name: Transfopoly
description: Physical serious game designed to guide participants through strategic decision-making in a gamified setup. Helps teams explore transformation scenarios, trade-offs, and priorities in an engaging, hands-on format.
